notes.title: Update 2.7.0: Galaxy Cup!
notes.notes:
The time has come, first Iteration of Galaxy Cup is live!

Win the 3 race cup by accumulating the most points, no restarts!

Changes:
- added Galaxy Cups!
- AI tweaks
- various polish and bug fixes

Happy racing!

2.6.1 Changes:
- added sky track g
- improved boost pads
- boost is now refilled on respawn
- fixed sky material on sky map
- removed certain test sky tracks

Happy racing!

notes.title: Update 2.6.0: Revamped Dart progression!
notes.notes:
This long in the works revamps Dart progression! 

Completing races now rewards currency that you can spend to unlock and upgrade Dart parts. This is another step towards Galaxy Cup! 

That update took a while to develop... Future ones will comes faster, the plan is for 2-3 updates per month. Next up are new tracks! 

2.6.0 Changes:
- added currency rewards for completing races
- rebalanced dart parts
- tweaked dart handling
- ai dart tweaks
- adjusted sky track f
- polished sky map environment
- various polish and bug fixes

Happy racing!
